verdict.rationale: The pack includes items sourced from a public GitHub repository (github.com/semgrep/semgrep), which suggests the core engine's source is publicly readable. However, no evidence item states the license, and a community comment notes that Semgrep Supply Chain is not open source, so parts of the product are closed. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of the open-source license, clarity on which components (engine vs. Pro/AppSec Platform features) are open, and independent corroboration of source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
